'''Vrblthers''', also spelled '''vrblthr''', were dangerous predators found on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Like the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], they were originally from the planet [[Varl/Legends|Varl]].

==History==
[[File:Vrblther.png|thumb|left|A Vrblther]]
They were bipedal creatures with a humanoid appearance, but with horns sticking out of their heads, and extremely sharp claws. Their thick, leathery hide ranged in color from black to dark green to brown.<ref name="ultimate">''[[Ultimate Adversaries]]''</ref> When the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] left [[Varl/Legends|Varl]], they took vrblthers with them to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="swtor" /> to use as pets, guard beasts, and for pit fighting. An [[Armored vrblther|armored sub-species]] of vrblther remained on Varl.<ref name="Wizard" /> The population of vrblthers grew rapidly on Nar Shaddaa after their introduction as they proved highly resistant to the toxins and pollutants of their new environment. Ever since then, in the "wilds" of Nar Shaddaa's lower levels, vrblthers typically hunted in packs.<ref name="swtor" />

While investigating an [[Circus Horrificus/Legends|animal-smuggling ring]] on Nar Shaddaa, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]] were attacked by a pack of vrblthers. They were subsequently vanquished by the two Jedi.

When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] searched Nar Shaddaa for [[Vima-Da-Boda]], a pack of vrblthers attacked them. One of the vrblthers bit Chewbacca on the shoulder.<ref name="DEII2">[[Dark Empire II 2|''Dark Empire II'' 2]]</ref>
